messages:
maria_cs: Weekly account health check — @channel noticed a jump in AcmeCorp error rate this week. Overall error rate 1.9% (vs 0.6% baseline). Can we get a breakdown by 5xx, timeouts, rate limits and the top failing endpoints? Need this for the renewal sync next week.

dan_eng: grabbing APM + gateway logs now. quick peek: 5xx ~0.9%, timeouts ~0.6%, rate_limits ~0.4% across the last 7d. will push per-endpoint numbers in a minute.

kevin_support: we have 3 active tickets from Acme — customers reporting slow responses and increased retries, seeing a lot of 429s in the ticket logs.

dan_eng: preliminary top failing endpoints by failure count: `/v1/generate` (45% of failures), `/v1/stream` (22%), `/v1/embeddings` (14%), `/v1/retry` (6%), others split the rest. Many 5xx correspond to long-context `/v1/generate` requests (>4k tokens). Snippet from logs: 
```
Error 502 x21: runtime nil deref at model.exec
Timeout 504 x18: request queued >30s, kv-cache miss
429 x12: rate-limiter trigged for customer token
```

maria_cs: notes: looks like long requests -> queueing -> timeouts/5xx. also saw a spike in embeddings traffic from Partner X Wed 22:00 UTC which correlates with the increased rate-limits.

ashley_am: flagging renewal risk — AcmeCorp exec review next Tue. Can we get an exec-friendly one-pager with numbers + mitigation plan by EOD tomorrow?

dan_eng: short-term mitigations we can do quickly: enable per-customer throttling for heavy endpoints, cap max tokens for Acme requests, and route long-context jobs to dedicated pool. Implemented a quick canary: reduced max tokens server-side from 8000 -> 6000 for Acme token.

kevin_support: ran synthetic tests against canary — 504s down ~35% on similar workload. Tickets updated with workaround steps.

maria_cs: can you drop exact 7-day counts and a histogram? need concrete numbers for the one-pager. Dashboard link would be great.

dan_eng: uploaded raw counts: s3://prod-metrics/acme/1764032105/errors.csv. Per-endpoint CSV also uploaded: s3://prod-metrics/acme/1764032105/per_endpoint.csv. Dashboard (live): https://redwood.internal/dashboards/acme/error-breakdown?range=7d

maria_cs: perfect. I'll draft the exec summary: current error rate 1.9% -> primary drivers: 5xx on long `/v1/generate` (0.9%), timeouts from queueing (0.6%), rate limits from bursty embeddings traffic (0.4%). Mitigations: token cap canary (reduced 504s 35%), enable per-customer throttling, plan for dedicated pool. I'll include customer impact and proposed timeline.

ashley_am: 10:30 PT tomorrow for a 30-min triage works for me. please add infra + support + AM. include rollback plan and suggested customer messaging.

ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0483 linked to thread 1764032105

maria_cs: added. I'll post the one-pager after the triage and update the thread. :thumbsup:
